mechanics.title: Conversion
mechanics.description: Converts optifine/sky definitions in resource packs to Nuit skyboxes; skipped when native Nuit skyboxes are present. Options exist to disable native Nuit-format skyboxes.

editor_notes: Only matters if the player enables a sky resource pack. Legacy FabricSkyBoxes loading is described as planned.
name: Nuit Interop
summary: Lets Nuit load OptiFine/MCPatcher custom sky resource packs by converting them to Nuit's skybox format at runtime. Conversion is best effort, so some skies may differ from OptiFine.
